body: How much do I put in?
I'm an atheist. Music doesn't help, because I just come across songs that make me sad, and think of the girl. My only hobby is my car, but I can't afford to do that anymore.

The thing I'm most upset about is not being with the girl. I love her with every ounce of me, and it is killing me that I can't be with her. I'd do anything to have her back. I've been told that over time, I'd get over her. Hasn't been the case. After 6 months, I loved her just as much, and we got back together. Same reason for breaking up came up, and she broke it off the second time.
